note: macOS-generated golden vectors for the OnlyCue LTC scheduling layer (LTCFrameStream and LTCSchedule). The C# OnlyCue.Core re-implementation must reproduce every case exactly. PCM is pinned by structure plus a ±16-sample run-length window around each join; every sample of a single frame is already pinned by golden/ltc-wire-v1.json. To regenerate after a deliberate change, delete golden/ltc-schedule-v1.json and re-run the suite.
